?Court No. - 88
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3682 of 2023
Applicant :- Bauwan Alias Neeraj

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhakar Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

Heard Sri Sudhakar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I,
for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.614 of 2021, under Sections 379, 411, 413, 414, 465, 468, 471 and 420 IPC,
Police Station Naubasta, District Kanpur Nagar during pendency of the trial.

sentences.text:
FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and two others and according to the FIR,
applicant was apprehended along with two others and from his possession a stolen motor cycle was recovered and thereafter on his pointing out number of other motorcycles were recovered from the house of co-accused Chhotte Chandel and twelve stolen motorcycles were recovered from the house of applicant and thereafter on his pointing out co-accused Mohan Singh was apprehended and from his house six stolen motorcycles were recovered.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and nothing incriminating was recovered from the possession of the applicant and on the basis of false and planted recovery applicant has been made accused in the Bauwan Alias Neeraj vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198569374/

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicant was not having any previous criminal history but after his arrest in the present matter he was made accused in as many as 14 other cases and he has explained the criminal history of applicant in paragraph-8 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
He further submitted that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 28.7.2021, i.e., for the last more than one and half years.

Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayerfor bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 28.7.2021 and on the same day, he was made accused in 14 other cases.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

Although as per allegation from the possession of applicant 12 two wheeler vehicles were recovered which were stolen one and applicant was using the same after changing their chassis number but in the present matter applicant is in jail since July, 2021,i.e., for the last about more than one and half years. Although applicant is having criminal history of 14 other cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph-8 to the affidavit filed in support of the present application and in paragraph-10 to the affidavit it has been averred that applicant was not having previous criminal history and when he was arrested in the present matter then he was made accused simultaneously in 14 other cases, therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Bauwan alias Neeraj be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 SKM  Bauwan Alias Neeraj vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198569374/
